# Flavor Isle — Smiths Grove, Kentucky

Family-owned diner since 1964, just off I-65 Exit 38. Hand-patted burgers,
thick shakes and crinkle fries, served at the walk-up window.

## Name and address

Name: Flavor Isle
Address: 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY 42171

## Phone numbers

Store line, (270) 563-4618: orders and questions.
Automated phone assistant line, (270) 563-7230: the assistant that answers
calls and texts.

## Hours

Hours are store local time (Central). The kitchen closes 30 minutes before close.

Monday: 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Tuesday: 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Wednesday: 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Thursday: 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Friday: 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Saturday: 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Sunday: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM

## What the diner serves

Hand-patted burgers, thick shakes and crinkle fries, served at the walk-up
window.

Cuisine: Burgers, American, Ice Cream

Price range: $0.52–$11.50

Walk-up window: Pickup at the walk-up window.

Parking for trucks and trailers: Yes — there is easy I-65 access and parking
near the diner. The parking guide on our Exit 38 page shows the nearby marked
spaces.

## How far away

I-65 Exit 38: 0.7 miles
Mammoth Cave National Park: 15 minutes from the park entrance
National Corvette Museum: about 15 minutes

Flavor Isle, 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY — 0.7 miles from I-65 Exit 38.
